description: This file contains utility functions related to team management in Mattermost, including default channel names, email domain restrictions, and admin role group checks.

classes.name: TeamService
classes.description: Service class providing team-related utilities such as default channels, email restrictions, and admin group checks.

methods.name: DefaultChannelNames
methods.description: Returns a list of default channel names, including experimental defaults if configured.

methods.name: IsEmailAddressAllowed
methods.description: Checks if an email address matches allowed domain restrictions.

methods.name: IsTeamEmailAllowed
methods.description: Determines if a user's email is permitted for team creation based on domain restrictions.

methods.name: GetAllowedDomains
methods.description: Retrieves allowed email domains for a user and team, considering guest restrictions.

methods.name: checkValidDomains
methods.description: Validates that a team's allowed domains conform to application-wide restrictions.

methods.name: userIsInAdminRoleGroup
methods.description: Checks if a user belongs to any admin role groups for a given syncable entity.
